attributes.title: tag_create
attributes.description: Create Tags via system.tag.configure with the handler-fixed Abort collision policy. Each item carries the target path and the configuration of the node to create. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a target outside the tag_create Target allowlist, inside the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), or a UDT definition without an explicit _types_ allowlist entry fails with permission_denied before anything executes. This Tool takes no Precondition token: Preflight proves every target absent with system.tag.exists and refuses an existing one with conflict (details.items[].reason = targetExists), so nothing is ever overwritten, and Abort keeps a target that appears in the race window from being replaced. An item never writes a Tag value (that is tag_write), never carries nested children (each child is its own item) and never names a node other than the target's own leaf (that is tag_rename's). Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-Mutation audit write gives auditRecorded=false, never a failure. The created node's tag_get_config re-read, with its tcf1 Tag config fingerprint, is Observed state for the caller's next Mutation and never decides success. Every request is bounded: 20 targets by default up to the 100-target hard maximum, and the deployment may raise the default through tagCreateMaxItems in the Runtime Target Policy; the path, each configuration, its nesting and the batch as a whole have finite ceilings, and an over-budget request is a limit_exceeded refusal before any native call. A refused Target, existence check or Precondition writes one Runtime audit decision row (none in off mode, fail-closed in required mode), and the Observed state carries its own budget so a per-item Native outcome is never replaced by an output-limit error.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: 1..100 create items: {"path": provider-qualified Tag, Folder or UDT definition config path, "config": the configuration of the node to create}. The target must not exist — an existing one is conflict, and nothing is overwritten. Default 20, hard maximum 100.
